# Process: Pot Cycle
**Process ID:** P-100  
**Version:** 2.0 (Approved)  
**Owner:** Shift Supervisor  
**Approver:** Site A Operations Lead  

> SYNTHETIC FIXTURE for DocBrain tests. Site A is fictional; nothing here describes a real plant.

## 1. Purpose
Run one batch of the synthetic pot cycle on Kiln K-1.

## 2. Roles & Responsibilities
| Role | Responsibility |
|------|----------------|
| Shift Supervisor | Authorises the batch and the lid opening. |
| Kiln Operator | Runs the cycle on Kiln K-1. |

## 3. Operating Limits
| Parameter | Limit | Evidence |
|-----------|-------|----------|
| Lid opening temperature | < 55 °C | Synthetic manufacturer sheet SA-MS-01 |
| Cycle duration | 12 h | Synthetic recipe SA-R-07 |

## 4. Steps
1. Confirm Kiln K-1 is below the lid opening temperature.
2. Shift Supervisor authorises the batch.
3. Kiln Operator starts the cycle.
